author: 灯守 ルカ

prediction.question: 鏡の湖で二人が目にする「約束の記憶」の正体とは？
options: ライラが隠し続けてきた過去の真実
二人を導く星の精霊の導き
鏡に映るもう一人の自分との遭遇

en.title: Voyage Through the Ages and the Mirrored Hill of Promise
en.premise: In place of the shattered pearl crystals, a 'premonition of tomorrow' now burns in my chest. Aboard the Asteria, Lyra and I venture beyond the memories of the deep sea, sailing toward a legendary land where stars are said to rain down upon the earth. Along our path, we discover the mysterious 'Mirror Lake'—a place that reflects the boundaries of the world—where we encounter the memory of a precious promise we could never have made. This is not a quest for the remnants of a lost civilization, but a journey to find a new story, woven by those who live in the here and now.

zh.title: 星霜的航路与镜中映照的约定之丘
zh.premise: 取代破碎珍珠晶体的，是我心中点燃的“对明日的预感”。我与莱拉驾驶着“阿斯特里亚号”，跨越海底的记忆，向着传说中星辰降临地面的之地进发。途中，我们抵达了据说能映照出世界边界的神秘“镜之湖”，并在那里触碰到了某段本不该存在、却至关重要的约定记忆。这不是一场寻找失落文明残骸的旅程，而是一场寻找由现世之人所编织的新故事的旅途。
